additional_adapters.name: HermesProof control-plane adapter
additional_adapters.reason: The proof/lock kernel is central to Dave’s workflow but this repo never records enable/call/test/release evidence into it.
additional_adapters.disposition: Integrate existing component; do not duplicate.

additional_adapters.name: Project/portfolio catalog MCP
additional_adapters.reason: Dave has 700+ repos; project reuse, dedupe, ownership and source-of-truth selection need a first-class searchable catalog.
additional_adapters.disposition: Implement new local MCP backed by SQLite plus GitHub/GitLab sync.

additional_adapters.name: Typed tool doctor/installer supervisor
additional_adapters.reason: Current scripts only clone/create snippets; they do not certify installs, protocols, health, versions or rollback.
additional_adapters.disposition: Replace current installer/preflight with asset-type adapters and protocol certification.

additional_adapters.name: Scoped local repo service (filesystem + git + worktrees)
additional_adapters.reason: Every project needs safe local editing, branch/worktree state, diff and build execution under project-root restrictions.
additional_adapters.disposition: Import existing connectors into the typed registry rather than installing duplicates.

additional_adapters.name: Package intelligence / OSV / SBOM / license adapter
additional_adapters.reason: Professional builds need current dependency versions, advisories, licenses, lockfiles and provenance across many ecosystems.
additional_adapters.disposition: Implement one normalized service rather than one server per package manager.

additional_adapters.name: Official Playwright MCP
additional_adapters.reason: The catalog only has CLI+skills; persistent agentic browser loops and self-healing exploration need the official MCP option.
additional_adapters.disposition: Add beside CLI and select by task profile.

additional_adapters.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
additional_adapters.reason: Performance traces, network/console debugging and browser diagnostics are missing from web/PWA/Electron coverage.
additional_adapters.disposition: Add on-demand with telemetry disabled by default.

additional_adapters.name: Secrets/credential broker
additional_adapters.reason: Tokens must not be embedded in snippets or logs; connectors need scoped references, rotation and redaction.
additional_adapters.disposition: Integrate Windows Credential Manager or an encrypted local vault; pass references, not raw secrets.

additional_adapters.name: Docker/WSL/SSH/VPS/runner adapter
additional_adapters.reason: Dave’s VPS, Docker, WSL and GitLab runner workflows are not covered.
additional_adapters.disposition: Implement a restricted infra MCP with host allowlists, plans, health and rollback.

additional_adapters.name: WinDbg/crash-dump/symbol adapter
additional_adapters.reason: x64dbg is interactive user-mode debugging; Windows crash dumps, symbols and kernel/native diagnosis remain uncovered.

additional_adapters.name: Android build/sign/publish adapter
additional_adapters.reason: Device automation is broad, but Gradle, SDK/NDK, signing, AAB/APK validation and release are missing.
additional_adapters.disposition: Implement as build/release service plus skill.

additional_adapters.name: Unity, Godot and Unreal editor adapters
additional_adapters.reason: Most game-creation ideas need editor scene/project/build control; current catalog is almost entirely reverse engineering.
additional_adapters.disposition: Add separate on-demand engine profiles; do not load all together.

additional_adapters.name: Blender and ComfyUI asset adapters
additional_adapters.reason: 3D, textures, image-to-3D and production asset workflows are recurring project needs.
additional_adapters.disposition: Add local GPU-aware media profile with asset manifests.

additional_adapters.name: LM Studio/Ollama/model registry adapter
additional_adapters.reason: Local/cloud provider health, model installation, VRAM routing and fallback are core to Dave’s setup.
additional_adapters.disposition: Implement one provider manager integrated with MiniMax routing.

additional_adapters.name: Database/migration/backup adapter
additional_adapters.reason: Professional apps and dashboards need schema, migrations, data tests and restores.

additional_adapters.name: Cloudflare/deployment adapter
additional_adapters.reason: Web services and agent backends need repeatable deploy, secrets, logs and rollback.
additional_adapters.disposition: Use Cloudflare-specific skills/API only for Cloudflare projects.

additional_adapters.name: Embedded serial/firmware adapter
additional_adapters.reason: Raspberry Pi, ESP, SKR motion and 3D-printer projects currently have no coverage.
additional_adapters.disposition: Add device allowlists and physical safety gates.
